facts.summary: Partner Daiichi Sankyo Europe disputes $300M milestone eligibility after CLEAR Outcomes · Phase 3 completed · bempedoic acid in cardiovascular risk reduction · filings planned
facts.indication: cardiovascular risk reduction in statin-intolerant patients

evidence.summary: DSE has conveyed that it disagrees with the Company’s assessment that the CLEAR Outcomes data would support the Company’s right to receive any milestone payments
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The study showed that NEXLETOL significantly reduced the risk of hard MACE-4 and MACE-3 by 13% and 15%, respectively
evidence.safety: The proportions of patients experiencing adverse events and serious adverse events were similar between the active and placebo treatment groups.
